description: This file contains the implementation of a utility function 'HALUTIL_GetModuleName' which extracts the module name from a file path string. It is part of the 'hal_utils' module and implements string processing logic to parse directory names.

methods.name: std::string HALUTIL_GetModuleName(const std::string & filePath)
methods.description: Extracts the module name from a given file path string by removing the filename and parent directories, leaving only the module folder name.
